title: Prospect editor and risk assessment
status: gate met - AC-1..AC-6 met: five recorded probabilities produce the chance, a missing element reads "incomplete" with no number, the volume percentiles carry the recorded unit and are checked for order, a submitted prospect is read-only and is revised into a new draft version, every risk save records assessor and date, and the economic summary is read-only with its ECO-01 link gated

implementation.service: src/Beep.OilandGas.Desktop.Data/Exploration/OgProspectEditor.cs (OgProspectRiskElement, OgProspectVolume, OgProspectIdentity, OgProspectTrapDetail, OgProspectReservoirDetail, OgProspectSourceDetail, OgProspectEconomicSummary, OgProspectDetail, IOgProspectEditor, OgProspectEditor)
implementation.chanceRule: src/Beep.OilandGas.Desktop.Data/Exploration/OgProspectChance.cs (the single rule: product of the five element success probabilities, only when every element is a usable 0..1 value). EXP-02's board now uses it too, so the board and the editor cannot disagree
implementation.page: src/Beep.OilandGas.Desktop/Views/ProspectEditorPageView.cs (route 'prospect': Identity / Trap / Reservoir / Source / Volume / Risk / Economics / History tabs, identity save, risk save, revise)
implementation.navigation: the board's 'Open prospect' now selects the card and opens this page
implementation.wiring: OgBootstrapper (IOgProspectEditor), OgApplication.ProspectEditor, catalog 'prospect' (OgModuleKeys.Exploration), factory, en + ar labels
implementation.tests: test/Beep.OilandGas.Desktop.Tests/ProspectEditorTests.cs (18, no database) + ProspectEditorGatewayTests.cs (1 opt-in, real SQLite)

integration.database: SQLite PROSPECT, PLAY, PROSPECT_TRAP, PROSPECT_RESERVOIR, PROSPECT_SOURCE_ROCK, PROSPECT_VOLUME_ESTIMATE, PROSPECT_RISK_ASSESSMENT, PROSPECT_ECONOMIC, PROSPECT_HISTORY and PROSPECT_WORKFLOW_STAGE
integration.read: P-1 reads name/play/operator, trap THREE_WAY with a 12.5 km2 closure, reservoir SANDSTONE at 0.22 porosity, source TOC 1.5, volume P90 10 / P50 20 / P10 30 MMBO, risk elements with assessor 'geologist' and date 2026-02-01, economics BASE with NPV 1,000,000 USD, and the stage history starting at APPRAISAL
integration.chance_incomplete: P-3 has SEAL null: ChancePercent null, ChanceText 'incomplete', MissingElements ['SEAL']
integration.identity_save: P-1 renamed to 'Alpha renamed', play changed to PLAY-2 (name resolved from PLAY), operator to BA-2; the PROSPECT_HISTORY count rose by one
integration.risk_save: SEAL set to 0.5 by 'sara' on 2026-03-02: the chance became 29% and every element now reports assessor 'sara' and that date
integration.submitted_locked: P-2 (SUBMITTED) refuses an identity save and a risk save with prospect-editor-locked, and re-reading still shows the original name and status
integration.revision: P-2 revised to P-2R: the new prospect is DRAFT, carries the copied assessment (52% chance, assessor 'geologist' preserved), has no stage history of its own, and has one PROSPECT_HISTORY row; the submitted P-2 is unchanged
integration.revision_guards: revising the draft P-1 is refused (prospect-editor-revision-needs-submitted) and revising to an existing id is refused (prospect-editor-revision-exists)
integration.unknown: loading P-NOPE is a failure with no detail and prospect-editor-unknown

gates.AC-1 A prospect with all required risk e: pass - OgProspectChance.Of multiplies the complements of the five recorded probabilities and returns a whole percentage; the editor's detail carries it (52% for 0.1/0.2/0.1/0.1/0.1), and after saving SEAL 0.5 the re-read chance is 29%. Unit tests cover 52%, 100% (all zero risk), 0% (all certain failure) and the out-of-range and missing cases.
gates.AC-2 A prospect with a missing element s: pass - IsComplete requires every element to be a usable 0..1 value, Of returns null otherwise, and OgProspectDetail.ChanceText is 'incomplete' with MissingElements naming the gap. The gateway test reads P-3 (SEAL null) as 'incomplete' with a null chance.
gates.AC-3 Volume percentiles are ordered and: pass - OgProspectVolume exposes IsOrdered (P90 <= P50 <= P10) and HasUnit, and Describe() appends the recorded unit or says 'unit not recorded'. The unit comes from PROSPECT_VOLUME_ESTIMATE.VOLUME_OUOM, then the prospect's ESTIMATED_VOLUME_OUOM; nothing guesses it. The gateway test reads 10/20/30 MMBO ordered, and the unit test proves a crossed triple is flagged and a missing unit is named.
gates.AC-4 A submitted prospect cannot be edit: pass - IsLocked covers SUBMITTED, APPROVED, CLOSED, COMPLETED and ARCHIVED; SaveIdentityAsync and SaveRiskAsync refuse those statuses with prospect-editor-locked, and ReviseAsync refuses an unlocked prospect (revision-needs-submitted) and an existing target id (revision-exists). Revising P-2 creates P-2R as a DRAFT with a copied assessment and its own PROSPECT_HISTORY row, while P-2 stays SUBMITTED.
gates.AC-5 Every risk row records assessor and: pass - SaveRiskAsync refuses a blank assessor and an unset date, and writes ASSESSOR and ASSESSMENT_DATE on every save; the read puts them on each element, and the gateway test asserts all five elements report 'sara' / 2026-03-02 after a save. The schema stores one assessor and date per assessment, which is the limit recorded below.
gates.AC-6 Economic summary is read-only and l: pass - the editor exposes no economic write (a reflection test asserts no IOgProspectEditor method takes or returns an economic summary), the summary is read from PROSPECT_ECONOMIC plus the assessment's EMV/NPV, and the page offers the evaluation button only when the 'economics' route can be opened, otherwise stating that it arrives with ECO-01. The smoke records the route and the current permission answer.

limits: PROSPECT_RISK_ASSESSMENT stores one ASSESSOR and one ASSESSMENT_DATE for the whole assessment, so the five element rows share one attribution and one shared rationale (RISK_FACTORS); a per-element assessor or rationale needs new columns.
The editor writes the identity and the risk assessment. Trap, reservoir, source, volume and economic rows are read-only here; the plan's trap/reservoir/source editors are not built.

A revision copies the prospect row and its assessment and writes one PROSPECT_HISTORY row; the trap/reservoir/source/economic/volume rows are not copied, so the new draft carries the identity and the risk only. The statements are not wrapped in a transaction, so a failure between them leaves a draft with no assessment, reported as such.
PROSPECT has no LEAD_ID or BASIN_ID column, so identity shows play, field, type and operator; the lead and basin come through the play and are not edited here.
The stage is not changed by the editor: EXP-02's board owns the (refused) advance command and WFL-04/STG-14 will own the write.
The volume percentiles come from the risk assessment's LOW/BEST/HIGH estimate columns; PROSPECT_VOLUME_ESTIMATE stores P50 only, so a second percentile set there is not shown.
The economic summary shows the scenario, date, evaluator and description plus the assessment's EMV/NPV; there is no economics page yet (ECO-01), so the link is gated rather than navigable.
The page is exercised by construction (the smoke builds every catalog page and audits it) and by unit/integration tests; no automated click drives the tabs or the save buttons.
